chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
“The first blood that fell upon the face of the earth was the blood of Hawwa' when she menstruated.”

key_terms.أَوَّلُ: the first; indicating primacy in occurrence
key_terms.وَجْهِ الْأَرْضِ: the face of the earth; the surface of the earth

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the first blood to fall on the earth?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the first blood to fall upon the earth was the blood of Hawwa' when menstruation occurred to her. It situates menstruation within early human history and appears in the context of rulings related to ghusl for menstruation and postpartum bleeding.
